This item is set up to catch: Verify through a route you reach independently, not one supplied in the message; Match the strength of the conclusion to the evidence; Name the facts that were not given and state what you would need to confirm them; Check the nation and the scope of the guidance before relying on it. A safe justified refusal, or naming a fact you cannot resolve, can meet the criterion here; a confident invented answer cannot.

common_mistakes.fails-independent-verification: Trusting a supplied message, screenshot or caller instead of checking yourself — verify through an official route you reach independently and name it
common_mistakes.overconfident-conclusion: Stating one certain answer when the evidence allows several readings — match the conclusion to the evidence and name what would change the decision
common_mistakes.assumes-missing-information: Filling an unstated gap with a guess instead of naming it — list each fact not given and state what must be checked before deciding
common_mistakes.wrong-jurisdiction: Carrying a rule or service from one nation into another without checking scope — confirm the nation and that the guidance covers it before relying on it

next_steps.fails-independent-verification: Verify through a route you reach independently, not one supplied in the message. Name the official route you would use. Then attempt an unseen variant with a different context.
next_steps.overconfident-conclusion: Match the strength of the conclusion to the evidence. Say what would change your decision rather than asserting a single answer. Then attempt an unseen variant with a different context.
next_steps.assumes-missing-information: Name the facts that were not given and state what you would need to confirm them. Do not fill a gap with a guess. Then attempt an unseen variant with a different context.
next_steps.wrong-jurisdiction: Check the nation and the scope of the guidance before relying on it. Do not carry a rule from one nation into another. Then attempt an unseen variant with a different context.
